dossier.headline: Eicher Motors' Q2 profit rises 15% but misses estimates
dossier.summary: Eicher Motors reported Q2 FY27 consolidated profit of ₹1,573 crore, up about 15%, on revenue up 20.3% to ₹7,421.72 crore. Profit fell short of the ₹1,626 crore analysts had expected, with raw material costs cited as a pressure point.
why_it_matters: The profit came in below analyst expectations despite double-digit growth
